verify.effects: Run the complete Penny verification target through the bounded shared queue.

doctor.effects: Read-only tool and local configuration diagnostics; no provisioning.

data-export.effects: Downloads the complete bounded product archive and latest erasure journal over authenticated HTTPS, or loopback HTTP; requires explicit origin and an owner-only session file. No provider call.

data-import.effects: Restores an archive into an empty isolated local installation with its latest erasure journal; preserves destination authority and holds archived mail. Hosted import remains refused.

data-journal.effects: Downloads the bounded erasure journal using current native operator authority; no private session is copied into it.

data-erase.effects: Applies an explicitly reviewed local erasure plan and saves the latest journal; hosted erasure remains refused.

artifact-prepare.effects: Packages an already-built committed source into an absent external artifact without provider credentials or writes.

artifact-deploy.effects: The disposable artifact controller reconciles explicitly scoped resources, exact hash-ledger migrations, upload and health with its private receipt.

artifact-health.effects: Reads disposable controller identity, resource drift and health against its private receipt; no resource writes.

setup.effects: Build, apply migrations, preserve private settings and owner, capture local sign-in and stop the temporary app. No deployment or sample import.

deploy.effects: Use persistent owner-account deploy.json policy and environment-specific private credentials/state; production is the default, named installs use preview runtime mode, and dry run builds and validates locally only.

deploy-health.effects: Read the selected environment's persistent owner-account deployment identity and health; production is the default. No local setup, provisioning or secret rotation.

feedback-import.effects: Prepares private saved feedback files, previews explicit mappings, applies bounded native D1 history, or reads/resumes/undoes an actor-bound saved job. Network actions require an explicit HTTPS or loopback origin and owner-only operator session file; no live source acquisition or provider effects.

saved-feedback-import.effects: Prepares or explicitly previews/applies/resumes/undoes saved feedback through current native operator authority and an owner-only session file. Persists bounded journal/original custody; no live acquisition, mail, webhook or publication effect.

importer-status.effects: Validates the seed-local documented-format entry and resolves its exact shipped guide bytes without a provider request or global registry mutation.

dev.effects: Serve source with HMR on the requested loopback URL; health and ordinary sign-in gate readiness. Shared queue, registry and owned cleanup.

preview.effects: Serve fixed built Worker through the shared managed runtime, reusing canonical local data and owner.

build.effects: Build real Worker and assets under shared private-settings custody.

reset.effects: Confirmed contained removal of canonical local state and generated settings; refuses active operations; preserves source, dependencies, exports and deployment receipts.

export.effects: Export supported local domain data and original files with a separate mandatory erasure journal; remote archive commands remain data:export.

import.effects: Restore a verified local archive and its latest sibling erasure journal into an empty destination; independently establish owner afterward; never sends effects.

release.effects: Maintained Base release producer; requires explicit authorized release inputs.

check.effects: Dependency-free first-party contract and copied-source inspection.

install.effects: Install the pinned frozen dependency lockfile without setup.
